notes.title: September 28, 2023 Update - 1.3.20

[list]
[*] Improved side by side vehicle driving to be way more stable
[*] Added aerial view for Gulp

notes.title: July 18, 2023 Update - 1.3.14
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Changed controls from just "B" to switch between Beast Blasters to be "1", "2", and "3" for Gulp, C Bun, and Kyle
[*] Made it so current rotation is maintained when switching between Beast Blasters rather than rotating to the rotation of the Beast Blaster the player switch to
[*] Fixed issues with the pause UI when in the side by side
[*] Increased volume of side by side engine and driving sounds
[*] Fixed problem where you couldn't become Kyle and he'd just say "nope"
[/list]
